ops.title: Route Watchman CI Rust compilation through existing sccache
ops.description:
Owner /root/watchman_full_suite_delivery. Independent small CI route fix; do not conflate it with the merged C/C++ base-cache task5c134 or the completed fixture task4210.

Actual trusted main seed41360916013 rebuilt Rust crates and reported Finished release profile in1m16s (whole-main-build-log65401-65540), while final sccache stats record1504C/C++ requests and noRust requests. The job installs sccache0.14 and enables GHAC, but its env has noRUSTC_WRAPPER. Root CMake includes RustStaticLibrary; its cargo invocation uses CMake -E env without clearing inherited variables or supplying a wrapper. Pinned mozilla-actions/sccache-action v0.0.10 docs explicitly show RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache for Rust; sccache0.14 supports that Cargo route. Final binaries/proc macros and incremental builds have cache limitations, so do not promise removal of the entire76seconds.

Next executable step: prepare an isolated one-line build-job env addition RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache, preserve existing toolchain/permissions/coverage/timeouts/two-worker settings, independently review before any publication/CI, then normal scoped publish/fullCI/merge and actualRust request/cacheable-result verification. Native product source and local services do not change. No local product build/test or synthetic/manual CI job.

Evidence under FE/f5c-full-suite-delivery/age-file-subwatcher-lifetime-source/cache-reuse-source/rust-wrapper-source and adjacent main-seed/actual-terminal/whole-main-build-log.stdout. Primary pinned contracts: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla-actions/sccache-action/v0.0.10/README.md and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla/sccache/v0.14.0/README.md. No speed claim until actual measurements.

ops.text: Actual Rust compilation duration, absence from sccache statistics and the documented missing wrapper route are source-bound; no unsupported full-speedup claim.

The minimal job-scoped route change is independently reviewed, normally published, passes genuine complete Mac CI, and is normally merged without changing permissions/toolchain/coverage/retry/timeout policy.

Actual Rust compiler requests and cacheable results verify the installed CI route, with measured duration and noncacheable limitations retained; no native payload/service update is claimed or performed.
